title: EXAMPLE ONLY: raise the admin multisig time lock to 24 hours (Squads config transaction)
notes: Documentation example (docs/security/verify-proposal.md). Placeholder multisig, not a real index. A config transaction changes the multisig itself; every action is flagged critical. minTimeLockSecs is the admin multisig floor on localnet and devnet (300 s, ADR 0020; the upgrade multisig floor is 3600 s; the pilot floors are 24 h admin and 7 d upgrade): the multisig's current time lock and the new value must both be at or above it.
